name: cli-tool
description: CLI tool hint pack — argument parsing, exit codes, testing, CI. Language-agnostic; research picks the concrete toolchain.
hints: Exit non-zero on failure; results to stdout, diagnostics to stderr.
Support --help and --version; keep flags documented and predictable.
Separate argument parsing from logic so the core is unit-testable.
Ship a Nix flake for a reproducible toolchain (see nix below).
research: Context7: argument-parsing library for the chosen language (clap / cobra / commander)
gh_grep: real CLIs in the same language and their packaging/CI
